title: Bitcoin Braces as Trump Slaps 25% Tariffs on Europe Over Greenland
summary: President Trump announced escalating tariffs on eight European nations starting February 1 until Denmark sells Greenland, triggering emergency EU meetings and unified condemnation from European leaders as Bitcoin faces renewed volatility mirroring October's tariff-driven liquidation crisis.The postBitcoin Braces as Trump Slaps 25% Tariffs on Europe Over Greenlandappeared first onCryptonews.
